QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Our Destined Roles
QuestInfo.0: A powerful energy is emanating from #bNoctis's#k seal. Luce had asked you to save her, but is such a thing really going to be possible?
QuestInfo.1: A powerful energy is emanating from #bNoctis's#k seal. Luce had asked you to save her, but is such a thing really going to be possible?
QuestInfo.2: After a bout with Noctis, you were able to resolve the misunderstanding. She gave you her and the remaining gods' powers in exchange for Luce's. Heading outside, it seems your allies were okay. Time to report back to the Alliance.
